contexts.text: The flags were bound to my head () ( = that false scientifics beset truth and good. AC 6726:end.) AE 538:11.

She set it in the flag by the bank of the river () = at first among false scientifics. The flag = scientifics... The reason a flag = what is scientific, is that in the Word every herb = some kind of what is scientific; a flag, which grows at the bank of a river, = a low Scientific; as in ... The reed and the flag = the lowest scientifics, which are sensuous. (Compare Sedge.)
She saw the coffer in the midst of the flag () = the perception that truth was in a low state among a false Scientific.
